extracted.intended_audience: aspiring and practicing fiction writers / readers of the Writers In The Storm blog
extracted.subtask_description: Short blog-format advice for creative writers emphasizing discipline and practical habits (one commenter highlights a single blunt tip about stopping procrastination and keeping a writing routine).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stop effing around and write
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Stop effing around and write' — the commenter identifies this blunt exhortation as the most resonant tip.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish a routine (the commenter wrote that they got into the habit of writing before work, which enabled finishing a long‑standing first draft). Beware of dropping the routine when switching tasks (the commenter notes editing a different story can derail their routine). The practical takeaway/anti‑pattern: stop procrastinating and commit to daily writing or editing; don’t let editing one project be an excuse to stop producing on another.
